probe_model_activations_with_AutoProbeD: use AutoProbeD as a context manager to probe a PyTorch model's linear inputs, outputs, weights, and gradients during forward and backward passes
log_custom_tensor_with_log_stats: call log_stats on any tensor with a name to log its statistics when AutoProbeD is active in the current context
compute_tensor_statistics_with_get_stats: use _get_stats to compute shape, mean, std, skew, kurtosis, min, max, and quantiles for a PyTorch tensor
probe_attention_logits_and_entropy: AutoProbeD automatically logs attention logits and entropy for SDPA and xFormers flash attention operations during model forward passes
disable_torch_compile_with_TorchCompileD: use TorchCompileDisabler as a context manager to temporarily disable torch.compile on a module and its submodules
